recordingId.description: Unique id of the recorded file.

conversationId.description: Conversation id of the recorded file.

conferenceId.description: Conference id of the recorded file.

callId.description: Call id of the recorded file.

direction.description: Call direction of the recorded file.

composed.description: Flag indicating whether the recorded file is composed.

duration.description: Duration of the recorded file in seconds.

participantId.description: Unique id of the participant associated with the recorded file.

participantIdentity.description: Unique identity of the participant associated with the recorded file.

participantName.description: Participant name associated with the recorded file.

participantType.description: Participant type associated with the recorded file. Values can be either customer or agent.

mediaType.description: Specifies recorded file type. Values can be either audio or audio and video.

startedAt.description: Unix timestamp for when the recording started.

deletedAt.description: Unix timestamp for when the recorded file was deleted.

deletedBy.description: Identity of the user who deleted the recorded file.

sftpPath.description: Location of the recorded file on the SFTP server.

transferredFrom.description: Identity of the user who has transferred the call.

transferredTo.description: Identity of the user to whom the call has been transferred.

transferredFromQueue.description: Queue id from which the call has been transferred.

transferredToQueue.description: Queue id to which the call has been transferred.
